reason: Primary purpose is a web UI enhancement plugin that adds a draggable Live2D desktop-pet style mascot to the DeepSeek Harness interface, with character/costume switching and interaction features. Evidence from README and project tree shows it is a browser-side UI overlay with local rendering assets and client injection pathways rather than backend logic.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中加载一个可拖拽的 Live2D 看板娘，支持角色与服装切换并提供点击与交互展示功能。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a draggable Live2D mascot widget to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with character and costume switching and interactive behavior.

capabilities: Injects a floating Live2D-based UI widget into the DeepSeek Harness web client
Supports drag-and-drop positioning and on-page control interactions for the mascot
Provides character/costume switching and click/idle behavior controls in the UI
Persists user-facing widget state via browser storage and serves bundled local assets for rendering

reasons.code: README describes a draggable bottom-right Live2D mascot with role/costume switching, interactions, hide/show, and screenshot actions.

Repository structure includes web client and routing sources (`src/client`, `src/routes.ts`) plus bundled visual assets (`assets/vendor`, `assets/model`, styles), indicating local rendering and injection behavior.
Package manifest declares a web plugin shape with host/client exports and dsh web client configuration, showing it is a browser-facing plugin extension.
